title: gfx950-tutorial-v2.0
description: Adds the two compiler changes the Gluon Flash Attention kernels need, on top 850a2b1), so the [Gluon] gl.warp_predicate — a per-wave masked-skip region lowering to [AMD] warp-pipeline barriers — always emit LOCAL cluster barriers rather Verified against the branch these were developed on: both attention kernels and all four inter_wave GEMM kernels (a16w16 fp16/bf16, a8w8, a4w4) compile to byte-identical assembly and pass their correctness checks.
